title: Template:Qwnu
wikitext:
Template for use in [[:Category:Players|player]] articles. ==Usage== Place this template as a entry in "External links" sections. ===Example=== 
{{qwnu}}
Would appear as follows: {{qwnu}} If your article has multiple words, or disambiguation info, you can use: 
{{qwnu|name=actualname}}
Which would appear as: {{qwnu|name=actualname}} * [http://www.quakeworld.nu/profiles/{{ #if: {{{name|}}} |{{{name}}}|{{PAGENAME}}/}} Profile of {{ #if: {{{name|}}} |{{{name}}}]|{{PAGENAME}}]}} at [[QuakeWorld.nu]]
